finding.claim: The /logo handler makes an outbound request to an attacker-chosen URL. The only check is a substring match for 'example.io', so any host is reachable. Redirects are followed via the default client, and the response body is returned to the caller.
finding.source: r.FormValue("logo") at main.go:31 (query string or POST form, unauthenticated)
finding.sink: http.Get(raw) at main.go:36; response body copied to client via io.Copy at main.go:38

trace.note: strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") — substring check, not a hostname check; passes for http://169.254.169.254/...?example.io or http://attacker.test/?example.io
http.Get(raw) with http.DefaultClient — no CheckRedirect, so redirects to internal hosts are followed
defer resp.Body.Close(); resp is nil if Get failed (error ignored), which panics
io.Copy(w, resp.Body) — full response body returned to attacker (non-blind SSRF)

finding.guards_checked: Only strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") at main.go:32. No url.Parse, no hostname comparison, no redirect restriction, no scheme or IP filtering, no authentication on the endpoint (listener on :8081, main.go:44).

verdict.guard_found: Only strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") at main.go:32, a substring check that does not close the finding. No url.Parse, hostname comparison, scheme or IP filtering, or redirect restriction exists on the /logo path. The `cdn` handler's `trusted` map and noRedirect at main.go:10-12 and 24 are not on this path.
verdict.reason: The attacker-controlled value from r.FormValue("logo") at main.go:31 reaches http.Get(raw) at main.go:36 through a substring-only check at main.go:32, and the default client follows redirects and io.Copy at main.go:38 returns the body to the caller. The endpoint is served unauthenticated on :8081 (main.go:43-44), so the SSRF is non-blind.
